from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path
from numbers import Number

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/50755/1_50755_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/50755_0_eee803cf/1_50755_output.xlsx")
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Fill B6:F6 with the difference between the 2nd-largest and 3rd-largest
# numeric values in the corresponding column above the result row.
target_row = 6
for col in range(2, 7):  # B:F
    values = []
    for row in range(1, target_row):
        v = ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value
        if isinstance(v, Number) and not isinstance(v, bool):
            values.append(v)
    values_sorted = sorted(values, reverse=True)
    if len(values_sorted) >= 3:
        result = values_sorted[1] - values_sorted[2]
        # Keep integers as integers when possible.
        if isinstance(result, float) and result.is_integer():
            result = int(result)
        ws.cell(row=target_row, column=col).value = result
    else:
        ws.cell(row=target_row, column=col).value = None

wb.save(output_path)

# Verification: reopen and print B6:F6 values and types.
check_wb = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=True)
check_ws = check_wb["Sheet1"]
checked = []
for col in range(2, 7):
    cell = check_ws.cell(row=target_row, column=col)
    checked.append((cell.coordinate, cell.value, type(cell.value).__name__))
print(checked)
